subject.title: chore(deps-dev): bump the development-minor-and-patch group across 1 directory with 13 updates

question: Should maintainers accept the new Socket obfuscated-code alerts for `@react-email/ui@6.6.6` and `@emnapi/runtime@1.11.1` via Vite/Rolldown, or require a narrower dependency update set?
rationale: The formatter failure is mechanical, but the supply-chain alert acceptance is a security-boundary decision that automation should not make silently.

options.title: Require secops alert triage first
options.body: Have a maintainer/secops reviewer inspect and explicitly accept or reject the Socket alerts before any merge decision.

options.title: Split out alerted packages
options.body: Regenerate a narrower Dependabot update that excludes the alerted React Email or Vite path if the alerts are not acceptable.

options.title: Accept risk after review
options.body: If the packages are acceptable, document that decision and proceed once the formatter output and CI are clean.

recommendation.title: Require secops alert triage first
recommendation.body: Have a maintainer/secops reviewer inspect and explicitly accept or reject the Socket alerts before any merge decision.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle is tied to the current tooling baseline and CODEOWNERS security-sensitive routing, making it the best available owner for the dependency risk decision.
